title: KA2L: A Knowledge-Aware Active Learning Framework for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2603.17566v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) with high-quality knowledge has been shown to enhance their performance effectively. However, there is a paucity of research on the depth of domain-specific knowledge comprehension by LLMs and the application of targeted active learning to improve their expertise. To address this gap, we introduce the Knowledge-Aware Active Learning (KA2L) framework. This framework assesses LLMs' mastery of specific knowledge points to aid in constructing unanswerable or unknowable questions through latent space analysis. This active learning strategy enhances training efficiency by focusing on knowledge the model has yet to master, thereby minimizing redundancy in learning already acquired information. This study innovatively employs a knowledge distribution probing technique to examine the hidden states of specific Transformer layers and identify the distribution of known and unknown knowledge within the LLM

translated_title: KA2L：一种面向大语言模型的知识感知主动学习框架
translated_abstract: 微调大语言模型（LLMs）并注入高质量知识已被证明能有效提升其性能。然而，关于LLMs对特定领域知识理解的深度以及应用针对性主动学习来增强其专业能力的研究仍然不足。为填补这一空白，我们引入了知识感知主动学习（KA2L）框架。该框架通过评估LLMs对特定知识点的掌握程度，并利用潜在空间分析来构建无法回答或不可知的问题。这种主动学习策略通过聚焦于模型尚未掌握的知识，减少对已学信息的重复学习，从而提升训练效率。本研究创新性地采用知识分布探测技术，检查特定Transformer层的隐藏状态，以识别LLM内部已知和未知知识的分布情况。
tldr: 提出了KA2L框架，利用潜在空间分析和知识分布探测技术，通过主动学习聚焦大语言模型未掌握的知识点，提升微调效率并增强领域专业知识。
en_tdlr: The KA2L framework leverages latent space analysis and knowledge distribution probing to focus active learning on unmastered knowledge points in LLMs, improving fine-tuning efficiency and domain expertise.
